Review Roundup: 'Go Set A Watchman' disappoints

At some point the marketing switched from "well, this is a draft but it might be of some historical interest" to "OMG! Harper Lee's second novel!"

Can't blame the publishers for wanting to get some more money out of it. Apparently Mockingbird has been selling like crazy too.

I picked up a copy. It's sitting next to my favorite chair. I've poured a nice glass of scotch...and yet I just can't open it.

She wrote the perfect novel. Drop the mic. Done.

This? If lucky it'll be forgotten. At worst, tarnish one of the greatest works in 20th century literature.

Worse, there's no god damned way I can read this with an open mind. Sigh.
Sort of my viewpoint, too. I love To Kill A Mockingbird and always appreciated it was as this "moment in time". This now makes me really worried that stuff by Salinger could start creeping out.
This is why ive chosen to ignore the existence of this book. I do not believe that publishing it was a choice she made. It was a cash grab by lawyers and publishers.

I have yet to read the book so take what I say with a grain of salt. The biggest backlash seems to stem from Finch now being characterized as a racist which people claim undermines a lot of TKAM. I don't know if people expected the same overused beaten-to-death racial themes to make up most of the new novel, but such a radical departure doesn't make it automatically bad. The two novels are just clearly about different things. Go Set a Watchmen seems to put forth an uglier, but certainly more interesting truth: that as a child we see our parents through a lens of perfection which more often than not isn't really there.

That is a really good point as well. It could be an interesting exploration of that phenomena. The quality depends on a variety of factors, but--for myself at least--it's tough to detach from something I consider a classic. But perhaps that's a lesson unto itself.
First thought on the new Harper Lee novel. "Also by this author: To kill a mockingbird". Has to be the most unnecessary "also by this author" blurb ever.

• Bonus gold for BH equals to bonus gold for allies.
  • Track is now a target area ability with an effect radius of 250. All enemies caught in the radius will have Track cast on them.

My thought process: Simply put the faster you get Track the more efficient you are. If we give BH an Aghs upgrade it would only make sense to rush it so every subsequent track kill will be more potent. Since 4200 gold would set him wwwaayy back on damage dealing (or anything else for that matter) the upgrade should be support orientated. So you give more gold to your team, track will be easier to get on all of the enemy team heroes and should have some scaling toward the very late game.

In competitive dota personally I've only ever seen him picked as a support roamer. Thoughts?

I'd love the Agh's upgrade to allow track to actually help get kills, rather than it just giving a bigger bonus from when the kills are secured.

Maybe agh's converts the movement speed bonus to a slow on the target.
